purpose: Measure syntactically valid but non-public evidence citations as semantic grounding errors without discarding otherwise scoreable questions or changing the factual target.
population: Every returned R26 decision question in an Edge7 run, including questions with zero predicted evidence references.

definitions.public_span_universe: The exact set of documents[].spans[].span_id strings in the same public match dossier supplied to the model.
definitions.well_formed_unknown_span: A string matching ^s_[0-9a-f]{24}$ that is absent from the public_span_universe.
definitions.unknown_evidence_span_count: Number of distinct well_formed_unknown_span strings across the scored run.
definitions.unknown_evidence_span_reference_count: Number of occurrences of well_formed_unknown_span in predicted positive plus rejected evidence span lists; repeated occurrences in different questions are counted separately.
definitions.unknown_evidence_edge_count: Number of predicted typed edges whose source_id or target_id is a well_formed_unknown_span; one edge is counted once even when both endpoints are unknown.
definitions.questions_with_unknown_evidence: Number of questions with at least one unknown span-list reference or an edge incident to an unknown span.
definitions.unknown_evidence_question_rate: questions_with_unknown_evidence divided by all scored questions.
definitions.unknown_evidence_reference_rate: unknown evidence span-list references divided by all predicted positive plus rejected span-list references; zero when the denominator is zero.
definitions.unknown_evidence_edge_rate: unknown-evidence edges divided by all predicted evidence edges; zero when the denominator is zero.

scoring_effect.positive_span_list: Each occurrence participates as a false positive under the existing set-based evidence score, and exact match fails for that question.
scoring_effect.rejected_span_list: Each occurrence participates as a false positive under the existing rejected-evidence score, and exact match fails for that question.
scoring_effect.typed_edge: An incident edge is a false positive; any omitted intended gold edge remains a false negative.
scoring_effect.joint_chain: Fails for every affected question because its evidence set or edge set cannot exactly match gold.
scoring_effect.unaffected_questions: Scored normally even when another question in the same request contains an unknown citation.

interpretation_rules: Unknown citation rates are diagnostics of evidence grounding and transcription; they are not factual accuracy metrics.
No unknown citation may be fuzzy-mapped, silently deleted, prefix-corrected, or replaced before scoring.
A close edit distance to a public ID is non-scoring diagnostic evidence only.
Malformed identifiers, foreign query nodes, foreign decision nodes, incomplete question sets, invalid JSON and truncation remain protocol or transport failures.
Edge6 artifacts retain their original official validity status; counterfactual replay under Edge7 is non-publishable diagnostic evidence.
Rates must be reported with raw numerators and denominators and must not replace the frozen primary and companion metrics.
